title: Traffic light queue
prompt: Simulate a traffic light that starts red with no cars waiting. Process the events in order: 0 = a car arrives: if the light is green and no car is waiting it passes immediately, otherwise it joins the waiting queue; 1 = the light turns green: if it was red, up to 3 waiting cars pass at once (all of them if fewer than 3 wait) and it becomes green; if it was already green nothing happens; 2 = the light turns red (nothing else happens; already red stays red). Events are always 0, 1 or 2. Return pair(number of cars that passed, number of cars still waiting at the end).
